title: Add 5-star rating system, view counter, and share functionality

requirements.summary: Implement a 5-star rating system on the Video Player page that allows users to rate videos from 1 to 5 stars, styled like the original 2005 YouTube star rating system
acceptanceCriteria: Display 5 clickable star icons on the VideoPlayer page
Clicking a star sets the rating for that video (1-5 stars)
Visual feedback shows which stars are selected
Style matches the classic 2005 YouTube aesthetic
Users can change their rating by clicking a different star

file_operations.description: Create a VideoRating component with 5 interactive star icons for rating videos. Implement hover effects showing which stars would be selected, handle click events to submit ratings, and display the user's current rating if one exists. Style the stars to match the 2005 YouTube aesthetic with gold/yellow coloring. Accept videoId as a prop and integrate with the useRateVideo and useGetUserRating hooks.

Create a mutation hook that calls the backend rateVideo method with videoId and star rating (1-5). On success, invalidate video metadata queries and user rating queries. Handle authorization errors gracefully and show toast notifications for success/error states.

Create a query hook that fetches the current user's rating for a specific video from the backend getUserRatings method, filtering for the specified videoId. Return the rating value or null if no rating exists. Only fetch when user is authenticated.

Import and integrate the VideoRating component into the VideoPlayer page. Position it below the video title and like button, creating a rating section that displays the interactive star rating interface. Ensure proper spacing and alignment with existing UI elements.

requirements.summary: Display the average star rating and total number of ratings for each video on the Video Player page
acceptanceCriteria: Show average rating as filled/half-filled stars
Update display when user submits a new rating

file_operations.description: Create a VideoRatingDisplay component that shows the average rating as filled/half-filled star icons and displays the total rating count. Accept videoId as a prop and use useAverageRating and useTotalRatings hooks to fetch data. Render read-only stars with partial fill for decimal ratings (e.g., 4.2 stars shows 4 full stars and 1 half star). Display formatted text like '4.2 stars (156 ratings)'.
Create a query hook that fetches the average rating for a specific video from the backend getAverageRating method. Return the numeric average (0-5) with proper error handling and loading states.
Create a query hook that fetches the total number of ratings for a specific video from the backend getTotalRatings method. Return the count as a number with proper error handling and loading states.

Update VideoRating component to include the VideoRatingDisplay component above the interactive rating stars, creating a complete rating section that shows both the aggregate statistics and the user's personal rating interface.

requirements.summary: Add a view counter to each video that increments every time the Video Player page is loaded for that specific video
acceptanceCriteria: View count increments when VideoPlayer page loads
Backend persists view count for each video
View count displays on the Video Player page using existing formatNumber utility
Multiple page loads by the same user count as separate views

file_operations.description: Ensure the existing useIncrementVideoView hook is called when the VideoPlayer component mounts with the current videoId. Verify the view count is displayed using the formatNumber utility from frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts. The view count should already be part of the video metadata; ensure it's prominently displayed near the video title.

requirements.summary: Add a 'Share' button on the Video Player page that copies the current video URL to the user's clipboard
acceptanceCriteria: Share button is visible on the VideoPlayer page
Clicking the button copies the full video URL to clipboard
Show a toast notification confirming successful copy
Button works on all modern browsers that support clipboard API

file_operations.description: Create a ShareButton component that displays a share icon button. On click, use navigator.clipboard.writeText() to copy the current window.location.href to the clipboard. Show a toast notification on success ('Link copied to clipboard!') and handle errors gracefully with fallback error messages. Style the button to match the YouTube-style dark theme.

Import and add the ShareButton component to the VideoPlayer page. Position it in the action bar alongside the like button and subscribe button, creating a cohesive row of video interaction controls. Ensure proper spacing and alignment with existing UI elements.
